scope.summary: Implement mask composition + management on StudioMask: combine (add/subtract/intersect between any mask sources; invert incl. duplicate-and-invert); manage (duplicate, rename, hide via eye toggle, delete); review (customizable overlay display — color overlay, color-on-black/white, image-on-black/white, white-on-black, equivalent modes); and local edit — each mask carries its own full develop slider stack (a mask-local StudioRawDevelop sub-stack), saveable as local-adjustment presets re-applied with an amount control. Intersect/subtract semantics + mask-component model are the canonical StudioMask semantics of 14.23; the develop pipeline does NOT fork them.
acceptance_criteria: mask combine/manage/review + mask-local develop sub-stack + local presets; canonical semantics; Argus + manual
expected_tests: test: add/subtract/intersect/invert + duplicate/rename/hide/delete + overlay review modes
test: mask-local develop sub-stack + save/reapply local-adjustment preset with amount

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Masking — compose, review & local edit

risk_if_missed: No mask composition/local-stack; local develop unusable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
